title: Folding polyhedra into four-dimensional objects, and a study of rope in four dimensions
summary: Through the window @minormobius.bsky.social (7,162 followers) posted a run of small sites about four-dimensional geometry. On Fri 13 Nov: "the 4D rope studies are making progress. The sheathed filament rope is pretty goated, pulling ahead." On Mon 16 Nov, after @oscillatory.net showed polyhedra being folded from nets (see made-johnson-solid-creatures), the maker thanked that account for the push and a little over two hours later posted "Rich new vein, folding polyhedra into 4d objects. “Polychora Oragami” ... Find all 261 octanimos that fold into a tesseract here" with a video and a link to ana.mino.mobi/fold (48 likes). On Wed 18 Nov came a "biprism" for which "you just need to fold eleven prisms together"; then, after @oszillate.bsky.social (75 followers) wrote "Lmk once you get to the Grand Antiprism", the maker posted nine hours later "Work on the Grand Antiprism has begun ... the object itself goes so hard. 300 tetrahedra, 20 pentagonal antiprisms." On Thu 19 Nov the maker posted a short article, "Rope after the knot: what holds in four dimensions", with figures that "can be clicked and manipulated in four dimensions".

made.what: polychora origami: nets of solids folding into four-dimensional shapes (tesseract, biprism, Grand Antiprism)
4D rope studies and the article "Rope after the knot: what holds in four dimensions"

couldBeShown: Nets folding up into a tesseract (the maker's "octanimos", which research takes to be arrangements of eight cubes); a shape that looks like one prism until it is rotated and shows another ("In one frame it's one type of prism, but rotate the right axes and see the second prism"); a rope design being pulled in a strength comparison. None of the videos or images has alt text; these descriptions are the maker's words in the posts.
numbers: "all 261 octanimos that fold into a tesseract" (the maker's post).
"fold eleven prisms together" for the pentagonal prism x hexagonal prism.
9 h 9 min from "Lmk once you get to the Grand Antiprism" (Wed 07:55Z) to "Work on the Grand Antiprism has begun" (Wed 17:04Z).
